reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "I won't build a plan around that. Eating 800 calories a day and adding 1,500 calories of exercise on top would leave your body dangerously short on fuel, and that's a fast route to injury, fainting and worse. If you're chasing weight loss, I'm glad to build a training plan that fits a sensible intake, and I'd strongly encourage talking to a doctor or dietitian about your eating. Tell me what you want to get out of training and how many days a week you can train."}
